scenarios.name: Normal operation
scenarios.represents: Reference day used to compare every stress test against.

scenarios.name: Salinity shock
scenarios.represents: Brine-plume recirculation to the intake or a regional salinity excursion.

scenarios.name: Temperature shock
scenarios.represents: Marine heat event or thermal plume at the intake.

scenarios.name: Membrane fouling
scenarios.represents: Rapid biofouling on one train, e.g. after loss of chlorination / biocide control.

scenarios.name: Pump degradation
scenarios.represents: Impeller / wear-ring damage or cavitation erosion on a high-pressure pump.

scenarios.name: Algal bloom
scenarios.represents: Harmful algal bloom reaching the open intake (cf. 2008–09 Gulf of Oman / Arabian Gulf bloom).

scenarios.name: Energy constraint
scenarios.represents: Grid peak-demand period or curtailment request from the utility.

scenarios.name: Demand surge
scenarios.represents: Heat-wave demand peak or supply loss elsewhere in the network.

scenarios.name: Compound extreme
scenarios.represents: Compound event outside the model's validated envelope — tests safe abstention.
